summary: This revision resolves the two proof-expansion requests and the example request from my v003 report. The endpoint recurrence in Proposition 5.4(3) is now proved by induction; the third-candidate comparison is reduced to an exact nonnegative alternating-sum identity with equality and empty-sum cases handled; and the new d=6, inertia-(2,2) example displays a full Horn/Pieri certificate. I found no material objection to the closed cost formula, chamber structure, or rank and uniqueness conclusions.
weaknesses: The result treats the special inertia-(m,2) family rather than arbitrary positive and negative multiplicities.
Some later chamber-count data remain computer-assisted, although the headline cost formula and structural conclusions have symbolic proofs.
